news.competitive_notes: XLK benefits from low expense ratio and high liquidity as a leading tech ETF, but its non-diversified, top-heavy concentration in a handful of mega-cap stocks (Apple, Microsoft, NVIDIA) means single-stock risk is elevated relative to broader market ETFs.
